chapterTitle: The Passive-Aggression Strategy: Dominate While Seeming to Submit
coreMove: A weaker operator survives by appearing compliant while quietly building parallel leverage that can eventually reverse the power balance.
modernTranslation: Hidden capacity under asymmetry can be prudent; it becomes corrosive when concealment replaces available good-faith confrontation.

ethicalSplit.legitimate: Quietly building leverage when direct challenge would be crushed and no fair channel exists.
ethicalSplit.illegitimate: Feigning submission while undermining trust in settings where direct, honest disagreement was possible.
